item.title: Requirements Contracts for Public School Athletic League Insurance and Benefits
item.description:
Education | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-12-09 In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Education is seeking proposals from insurers, brokers and claims administrators for a requirements contract to provide accident, medical and dental coverage for student athletes in Public Schools Athletic League activities, with responses due Dec. 9, 2026.

The New York City Public Schools (NYCPS), on behalf of the Public Schools Athletic League (PSAL), is establishing a requirements contract for a comprehensive student accident insurance program. To fulfill the ongoing needs of the league, PSAL is seeking proposals from qualified insurance carriers, agencies, brokers, or authorized third-party administrators ('Proposers'). The selected provider will deliver accident, medical, and dental insurance coverage, alongside related claims administration services, for eligible participants in PSAL-sponsored interscholastic athletic activities.

Notes:

  • The requested insurance program is strictly limited to eligible student athletes and authorized participants in approved, PSAL-sponsored interscholastic athletic activities.
